open_questions: Cuts: tests pin 68 nodes and ids are used by story/icons/code. Approve a cut pass (list below) with the matching test/story updates, or keep all ids and only zero cost / merge effects?

Bot policy: may the Producer change the bot to buy the branch unlock before FND_LEDGER / FND_RIVAL_WATCH and to expand like a human (planets, pairs, systems 2 and 3), so retuned nodes get measured? Without it MIL_13, LUX_13, LUX_14, BIO_12, BIO_13, LUX_7 stay unjudged.

BIO cash drain: is the culture lab (or its goods) meant to be a cash sink early? If not, the fix is the lab build cost / BIO goods margin (workshop keys), not BIO_1. UNKNOWN: current lab cost, I did not open it.
handoff: Review only, hand reasoning, nothing changed, no sim. Point supply: bot undercounts. Sources are once each: 1 per planet, 1 per distinct pair, 2 per system entered (systems 2 and 3 = 4), prosperity first tier ever t2 = 1, t3 = 2 (3 total, not per world), minus 4 for permits (2 + 2, spent from the same pool; not in skill_log). A human who visits ~12 planets and ~8 pairs earns ~27, nets ~23 after permits; tree for FND + one branch is 28-30. So choices exist, but at ~23 not the 25-32 I estimated before. The bot nets 5-9 because it runs 1-7 lanes and few planets, then spends the first 5 on FND_LEDGER and FND_RIVAL_WATCH, so it never reaches a branch. Not representative. Priority: cut RIVAL_WATCH, fix bot order, check BIO lab cost.

point_supply.is_bot_representative: No. Bot evidence: base run with 19 lanes and 12 ships (seed 2) spent only 7 points + 4 on permits = about 11 earned, because lane points count once per distinct pair, planet points once per planet, and the bot reuses few pairs. 'Points left' is 0 in 303 of 304 runs: every point earned is spent at once, in cheap-first order (FND_PERMIT, STORAGE, PROSPECT, LEDGER, RIVAL_WATCH), so branch nodes (cost 1 unlock then 2 to 3) are never affordable.
point_supply.real_supply_estimate: Planets 5 in system 1 plus those of systems 2 and 3 (UNKNOWN count, assume ~12 reachable) = 12; pairs reachable and used ~8; systems 4; prosperity 3 (only the first time any world reaches t2 and t3, balance prosperity_points_t2 1, t3 2). Gross ~27, permits -4, net ~23 by cycle 35. Range 15 (cautious) to 28 (explorer).
point_supply.tree_cost: FND 3 gate + 4 optional (LEDGER 1, RIVAL_WATCH 1, DOCKS 2) = 7; one branch about 21-23. Needed for one branch run = 3 + 21 = 24 points: slightly more than the net supply, so a human buys nearly the whole branch and skips the optional FND nodes. That is OK: the branch choice is real (cannot take two), the within-branch choice is thin.
point_supply.pacing_consequence: Points arrive mostly early (planets/pairs by cycle ~15) except systems and prosperity (late). The 3 gate points plus branch unlock (4 points) should arrive by about cycle 6-8. Bot supply of ~5 total means unlock at point 4 and nothing else, which is a bot artefact.

qa_answers.bot_supply: Not representative of human play. See point_supply. Net ~5-9 versus ~23 human estimate; 3 of 4 factors are bot expansion (few planets and pairs), cheap-first buying and counting only skill_log (permit points are paid from the same pool).
qa_answers.ledger_ablation: Confounded by substitution: removing LEDGER makes the bot buy RIVAL_WATCH or DOCKS, so cash delta is noise. Do not draw any value from it.
qa_answers.bio_1_trap: Partly. The point is cheap; the drain is the lab and its inputs. See rank 2.
qa_answers.no_win_in_batch: No bot founds the Bazaar, so win pacing (targets 22-26 skilled, 26-30 none) is unjudged by this batch. Cash 20-30k by cycle 40 with 6-12 ships is plausible for a Bazaar bill, but UNKNOWN.

details.ship_cap_15_check: No skill raises the cap.
